packMeta.name: Finance OS (AU) (SoftN + Forms)
packMeta.description: Turnkey Australian AFSL advisory & compliance workbench: client onboarding, Best Interest Duty risk profile scorer, Fee Disclosure Statements (FDS), superannuation rollovers, 100%-validated BDBNs, off-market transfers, annual reviews and document vault. Includes the full-stack SoftN application plus 8 schema-matched FormLogic forms & management charts sharing the same live SQLite database.
